criteria.artifactLogic: Version/channel/architecture, authenticated bytes, package closure and acquisition/digest/refusal tests; synthetic evidence is not desktop acceptance
criteria.A: Clean authentic package, ordinary launch, usable window, conversation, setting change and quit/reopen; arm64 evidence reusable only for recorded identity; native x64 still required
criteria.prepublication: Exact A/B bytes, stopped app/backend, same-path replacement, ordinary B launch/version/UI/settings/quit/reopen and required recovery
criteria.publicUpdate: A Check Updates/Open Release, actual public page, architecture-correct download, integrity, ordinary quit, same-path install and B acceptance; unsigned manual path only
criteria.recovery: Acquisition/digest failure preserves A; replacement failure leaves usable A or verified recovery; restored A ordinary launch with pre-B state, never B-modified data

evidence.ordinaryObserver: Human or bounded external observer; no debugger or direct executable substitution
bindings: exact A/B source and artifact identities
evidence.privacy: No profiles, credentials or arbitrary window contents exported
evidence.publisher: Manual/local records remain separate evidence, not trusted qualification merely through hashing/upload; existing protected publisher unchanged
evidence.futureManualConsumption: Requires Accepted reviewed attestor/binding/refusal design before publisher integration
evidence.postpublication: Bind to immutable manifest without rewriting it

alternatives.hostedAXOnly: Requires known-good-window demonstration and role-aware main/backend identity before further use
alternatives.dropX64: Not selected; changes user support scope

failurePolicy: Preserve first failure; finite execution and verified owned cleanup; uncertain containment retains roots; stop rather than automatic retries
